name: Basic Techniques in Modelling Complex Systems
description:
Motivation
The constant change of the world and the systems we live in demands decisions to be made on a constant basis. Many examples of well-intentioned decisions that at first glance appeared completely plausible – be it in economy, environment or society – lost their effects after a short time, increased problems or unintentionally even created new problems.

Acquired Competencies
Awareness and basic understanding of complexity as one of the biggest challenges in the business context. Ability to support the decision-making process with comprehensive knowledge of building and applying models in a business context.
